title: Click-Clack Cuttlefish
statement: Hovering in a twilight garden of swaying kelp and sunken apothecary bottles, this inquisitive cephalopod spends its days briskly tapping bits of frosted sea glass into intricate, ever-shifting mosaics on the sand. As it ponders each new arrangement, ripples of warm amber and electric indigo race across its skin like visible daydreams.
